title: RRE Current Evidence Consumption
purpose: Consume only W8C RRE-eligible current evidence into the existing Reality Readout Engine, preserving evidence lineage and required-lane coverage without deriving or admitting runtime positions.
rules: Only evidence marked RRE_ELIGIBLE by W8C may be consumed.
No Dossier receives an RRE record unless at least one RRE-eligible evidence record exists for that Dossier.
RRE evidence references must preserve W8C claim IDs and lane lineage.
Required-lane completeness is measured against W7 readiness and must remain explicit.
Incomplete required-lane coverage may produce a limited RRE readout but cannot become position-derivation-ready.
Complete required-lane coverage means evidence coverage is sufficient for the next derivation stage; it does not itself establish grammar, reality domain or runtime position.
W8D never writes CURRENT_DATA values into contemporary-runtime-dossiers-v1.json.
W8D never invents observables, metrics, signals, runtime positions or projections from absent evidence.
